subject: Architecture Review — logistics, runbook & advance materials
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@octant.ai>, Pete Lang <pete@octant.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Architecture Review — logistics, runbook & advance materials

Hi Sara / Pete,

Thanks for agreeing to the technical deep-dive. To make the session as useful as possible, we want to confirm logistics and share advance materials for review. Proposed details: 

- Purpose: 60–75 minute architecture review to walk through serving/runtime design, deployment considerations, and integration checklist for a production rollout.
- Proposed slots (PT):
  1) Thu Aug 13 — 10:00–11:15 PT
  2) Fri Aug 14 — 10:00–11:15 PT
  3) Mon Aug 17 — 13:00–14:15 PT

Please confirm which slot works best for you (we’ll lock calendar as soon as you reply). If none of those work, send two alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Attached are the initial materials we’ll reference:
- arch-review-agenda.pdf (high-level agenda + timeboxes)
- redwood_arch_diagram_v2.png (system diagram + routing and cache layers)
- runbook-ops.md (short runbook: expected telemetry, troubleshooting checklist)

Quick ask: could you share the names and roles of any additional Octant attendees (security, infra, product) so we can tailor the agenda? If you have particular questions (e.g., kv cache behavior, p99 tail latency, cold-starts with long contexts), call them out and we’ll include focused slides.

Links: agenda and editable slides live here: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-arch-review
Meet link (tentative): https://meet.redwood.ai/j/82416-arch-review

Thanks — we’ll aim to have a compact set of pre-reads (8–10 slides + diagram) you can scan in 10 minutes before the call.

—
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachments: arch-review-agenda.pdf, redwood_arch_diagram_v2.png, runbook-ops.md
From: Sara Patel <sara@octant.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pete Lang <pete@octant.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Architecture Review — logistics, runbook & advance materials

Thanks Markus — appreciate the materials. Quick answers:

- Attendees from our side: Sara Patel (Director, Infra), Pete Lang (Head of Platform), plus our security lead (Anika Rao) — she’ll want to review telemetry and retention.
- Preferred slot: Fri Aug 14 10:00–11:15 PT (the team is free then). If you can do that slot, great. If not, we can fall back to Mon Aug 17 13:00 PT.

Couple of asks for the agenda:
- Please allocate 20 minutes for an engineering Q&A focused on KV cache behavior with long contexts and fallbacks to smaller quantized model variants.
- We’ll have a short procurement/security checklist at the end — could you have somebody from your privacy/compliance team on the invite or on-call?

I scanned the diagram and I have two specific items we’ll want you to call out:
1) How request routing prioritizes latency vs. cost (example scenarios)
2) How you instrument and expose per-route p50/p95/p99 token metrics and what retention windows look like by default.

If Aug 14 works for you, please send the calendar invite with the final agenda and any short preread notes we should focus on.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Patel
Director, Infrastructure
Octant Analytics

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@octant.ai>, Pete Lang <pete@octant.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Architecture Review — logistics, runbook & advance materials

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming attendees. Aug 14 10:00–11:15 PT works for us and I’ve penciled in the slot; Markus will send the calendar invite once we finalize presenters.

Updated agenda (timeboxed):
- 10:00–10:10 — Welcome, goals & success criteria (Markus)
- 10:10–10:30 — Serving runtime deep-dive: batching, KV cache, quantization path (Stephanie)
- 10:30–10:45 — Model routing, variant fallback, and cost controls (Jonas)
- 10:45–11:00 — Integration checklist & runbook highlights (Laura)
- 11:00–11:15 — Live Q&A / open items (all)

Action items for Octant before the call:
- Please review pages 2–7 of arch-review-agenda.pdf (slides 1–6 in the deck) — those cover the system diagram and fallback flows.
- If you have a short set of representative prompts (5–10) that reflect production mix, upload them here: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-arch-review (we'll use them for latency examples).
- If Anika (security) has a SOC/retention-specific list, send it to me in advance; we’ll have our compliance engineer stand by for the end of the call.

Notes: Stephanie will focus on observable signals we expose out of the box (p50/p95/p99, token counts, cold-start windows). Jonas will touch on kernel selection and quantization tradeoffs for 8k+ context lengths.

I attached an updated agenda pdf with slide notes (arch-review-agenda.pdf). Markus: please confirm presenters and add the calendar invite when you have a moment.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: arch-review-agenda.pdf
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@octant.ai>, Pete Lang <pete@octant.ai>

Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Architecture Review — logistics, runbook & advance materials

Hi all — small addendum ahead of the call on Aug 14: I uploaded a one-page run order and a short checklist to the Drive folder (see link below) and attached the final agenda PDF.

Two quick asks from the runtime side so we can prepare targeted examples:
- Please share a sample prompt set (5–10 prompts) and an expected tokens-per-request distribution if you can — that’ll let us show realistic batching behavior and cost implications.
- If you have specific telemetry requirements, flag them now (examples we commonly get: p99 tail latency over 24h, tokens-per-call distribution, per-route token retention). We'll include concrete config snippets in the runbook.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-arch-review
Calendar: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/82416-arch-review

I attached: arch-review-agenda.pdf (final)

See you on Aug 14 — we’ll be prepared to demo both a greenfield streaming flow and a fallback to a lower-cost quantized variant for longer contexts.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Staff Software Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
